note: Release notes shown in the update prompt and the What's new panel. Newest first. Edit this file only — src/data/changelog.ts imports it and re-fetches it from the network so a stale tab can name the build it is about to receive.

releases.title: Fluid Mechanics drills are now scored

changes.text: Fluid Mechanics is marked: the booklet's printed key for all 148 items is in, so pressure, plane and curved surfaces, buoyancy, dams, metacenter and rigid-body motion now come back right or wrong.
Update notices now say what changed before you reload, and a What's new panel keeps the history.
90 Physics items across eight topics, from rectilinear and projectile motion through forces and gravitation to work, energy and momentum.
Ten Physics figures cropped from the booklet, sized so a tall diagram no longer pushes the answer choices off the screen.

releases.title: Leave a drill and come back to it

changes.text: Leaving a drill now asks whether to keep it. Unfinished drills and finished ones are listed in their own panel beside the topic picker.
Statics is keyed — all 176 items, across forces, equilibrium, frames, friction and cables.
The topic picker no longer pre-selects a subject, so a drill is always one you chose.
Powers and roots were printing as escape codes, so "4 cm³/sec" arrived as a jumble of letters and digits.
Calculus figures 40 and 41 were cropped through the drawing; both were re-cut.
Differential equations item 126 asked for a reading at 110° without saying half a minute.

releases.title: Analytics, ratings and the Fluent 2 skins

changes.text: Performance analytics built from your own stored answers, with topic mastery weighted by how hard you rated each item.
Rate any item easy, mid or hard; hard items come back more often in the next draw.
The two Fluent 2 skins lead the theme picker, with glass, gradient and pointer-driven depth.
A by-topic drill no longer reports itself as a board sitting.
